data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 3 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-3.svg)

Jun 19, 2023

## [Mistake in Ordering, Lulu & Georgia helped](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64904c82c42344628679fa8d)
I made a mistake in ordering - a rug was being delivered to the wrong address. Lulu and Georgia's customer rep helped me rectify the situation pretty quickly and she was responsive and helpful - which I really appreciated. The only reason I didn't give 4 stars is that (1) it would have been better if I could have spoken with someone on the phone rather than through the chat, it's just not efficient sometimes and (2) there is no way to quickly correct a mistake - I realized it as soon as I placed the order but couldn't get anyone to help me immediately even though I contacted Lulu and Georgia by email right away -by the time they got back to me 2 business days later it was too late and the rug had already shipped.

June 4, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 20, 2023

Hello Trupti, thank you so much for your feedback and apologies for any inconvenience that this experience has caused you. We are glad to hear that our Customer Experience team was able to update the shipping address on your order. We are available on Live Chat Monday-Friday and we also offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
